item: Stoplist batch 5 (R131, language group 4): 146 function, number and calendar words in id ms tl; Vietnamese left out on purpose
summary: Fourth T5 batch under the maintainer's go (R131): id 46, ms 63, tl 37 words from the triage's accepted candidates (64 function words, 66 number words, 9 calendar words, 2 attribution verbs, 5 quoted-word debris) against the same merged log as the earlier groups (sha256 6467504ab8ab); ms.yml and tl.yml are new files. Reading each word's other languages left out id ke-80 and ke-81 (the independence anniversaries), id isn and two Arabic prayer words, ms empat (Catalan draw), tl nang (the city Da Nang) and tl rin (the Japanese given name), naman (the Indian given name), kanya (Hindi Virgo), halos and mula. Vietnamese is left out on purpose: 73 of its 82 candidates are fragments, every Vietnamese syllable is a word and the keywords are built of them (thủ in thủ tướng, nẵng in Đà Nẵng), so it waits for a reader of Vietnamese. The 146 words are declared in test_analytics_extract with the curly spelling of the five apostrophe forms. Hidden at query time, no re-index. Left: Japanese, Korean and Chinese, the single-reader languages and the layout PR.
